article.title: Grantor’s transferee not bound by license.
article.content: When the grantor of the license transfers the property affected thereby, the transferee is not as such bound by the license.
article.html:
59Grantor’s transferee not bound by license.

Section 59 · Chapter VI · page 19 of the Act

When the grantor of the license transfers the property affected thereby, the transferee is not as such bound by the license.
